page.notes: The left margin notes are cut off and mostly unreadable; the right margin notes are as transcribed. Some words in the text are uncertain, e.g. "pervareretur" (perhaps "perueniretur"), marked where doubtful. The line "ducem" in the left margin is a faint fragment and is uncertain. Marginal fragments at the left edge are partly cut off; readings there are uncertain. Right-margin notes are small and run in blocks.
